snippet.title: Asterz - PlayStation Portable Homebrew Gameplay
snippet.description:
Asterz is a shoot-em-up space game partly inspired by the classic shooter Asteroids, originally released in 1979 by Atari. This homebrew is made by Team Duck Production, with a unqiue combination of utilizing 3D rendering and 2D object.

It was submitted to the NEO Spring Coding Compo 2009 (PSP Game, 2nd place).

Link: https://www.gamebrew.org/wiki/Asterz_PSP
